        "All six owned files were read, including the fully deleted31-line InstallTrigger test and the already disabled manifest entry. This comm patch adapts tests/fixtures to mozAddonManager; it does not remove the upstream production InstallTrigger implementation. The port title is not independent proof of that upstream implementation.",
        "The enterprise fixture catches any rejected createInstall/install promise, then dispatches mozAddonManagerDone. The Canceled comment does not narrow a catch-all to cancellation only. The event means the attempt settled; it does not assert installation succeeded. Both changed policy tests register their listener before click, separately wait for blocked/permission notification, dismiss it, await Done and close the tab.",
        "The allowed source uses HTTPS example.com and the webapi.testing test preference. Built-in certificate and user activation requirements are relaxed only by harness preference setup. This fixture anchor without href and programmatic click are test mechanisms, not a production accessibility or security configuration pattern.",
        "The unsigned test calls installMozAM and independently waits on onInstallCancelled before checking AddonManager.getAddonByID is null. The fixture helper returns the install promise, but the spawned callback does not await/return it; do not substitute its spawn completion for the cancellation listener or enterprise Done event.",
        "All relevant scalar assertions and notification-helper assertions have non-empty expected-behavior messages. Some existing messages omit should; that alone is not reported as a defect. No browser test, lint, extension installation, notification UI or API request was executed. Current WebExtension test paths have moved to mail/base/test/browser/webextensions; the owned historical path remains distinct.",
